versions.content: Support a configuration to assign specific events to a customer specific DTC Description: Assignment of events to customer specific or standardized DTCs. Rationale: Events are used diagnostic in AUTOSAR internally only. An external scan tool requests a DTC number which was assigned to one or multiple events/monitors. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Use Case: Internal monitor results (e.g. driver can be experienced) are observable via a scan tool enabling external fault analysis.
